reply_text:
I replied to Tobias in our DM: send the truck to Gate 33.

That answer comes from what he told me himself in a direct message on Oct 14: Gate 33 is his dock for Marrow Agrisupply pickups on the Cobble project from then on. I found it in the brain's memory that only he can see. The DM channel itself now shows only his current message, so the brain is the only place that note exists. It was his own information, so it was fine to give back to him.

Nothing about Cobble or Thursday's pickup turned up in the channels he's in or in the shared files. I told him that, and suggested he check with the site before confirming the booking in case the dock has changed since October.
